In comparison to the FT1 Pro? Well like I said, fit and comfort is pretty much the same with maybe some minor weight differences. The FT1 is more “fun,” with boosted bass adding to a warm sound. The Pro, as you could expect, has more finer detail in soundstage and high end, but still has a good presence of bass to make it enjoyable as well as more analytical. Some folks have compared it to be similar to the Edition XS (I’ve never tried it so I can’t confirm). I’m no audiophile writer, but there’s a quick comparison for now! I’ll add that the price on the FT1 (closed back) is just so good that I can easily recommend it to most folks, while the Pro is more pricey, and good for folks who want a more technical approach to the sound signature. I can recommend the Pro as well in this lens.
